patches_added.name: Android TV
patches_added.description: Adds full Android TV / Fire TV support: manifest declarations, TV launcher entry and D-pad remote navigation (focusable content rows, focus out of the top bar, dialog focus). Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches_added.name: Android TV: D-pad navigation
patches_added.description: Part of Android TV: makes the app fully navigable with a TV / Fire TV remote (focusable content rows, D-pad focus out of the top bar, dialog focus). Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches_added.name: Rebranding
patches_added.description: Renames the app to 'Anime Witcher +', changes the package id to app.catsmoker.anime.witcher, badges the icon with a red +, points Telegram links to https://t.me/CATSM0KER and credits the About screen. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches_added.name: Rebranding: Telegram & About
patches_added.description: Part of Rebranding: points Telegram links to the configured handle (default https://t.me/CATSM0KER) and adds a bold credit line to the About screen. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches_removed.name: Android TV support
patches_removed.description: Adds Android TV / Fire TV support (manifest declarations + TV launcher entry).

patches_removed.name: TV D-pad navigation
patches_removed.description: Makes the app fully navigable with a TV / Fire TV remote (focusable content rows, D-pad focus out of the top bar, dialog focus).

patches_modified.name: Disable VPN detection and alerts
patches_modified.description: Removes VPN/DNS detection and the VPN alert dialogs. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Disables all ad display logic in the app. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches_modified.name: Play with external player
patches_modified.description: Opens episodes in a system intent chooser so the user can pick their favorite video player (VLC, MX Player, etc.). Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches_modified.name: Remove AppLovin initialization
patches_modified.description: Removes AppLovin SDK initialization from the Application class. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches_modified.name: Remove startup popup
patches_modified.description: Removes the update/changelog and appearance popups that appear when the app starts. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches_modified.name: Clean main UI
patches_modified.description: Hides the bottom navigation bar, the top-right guide icon, and the Rate/Help/About drawer items, and brings the connect/create/join buttons to front. Reapplied on create, resume, and drawer open (and retried for ~1.8s after each) since some of these views are inflated lazily.

patches_modified.name: Skip splash screen
patches_modified.description: Jumps straight to the main activity from the splash screen, skipping the splash animation entirely. Also restores the storage-permission request and local media scan that the splash screen normally performs, so the Apps/Photo/Video tabs still load.

patches_modified.name: Speed up splash screen
patches_modified.description: Enters the main activity directly after the splash permission check instead of delaying for the additional external-storage check.

patches_added.name: Hide Me tab promo items
patches_added.description: Collapses the WhatsApp, Legal, and Help entries on the Me tab.

patches_added.name: Hide local tiles banner
patches_added.description: Collapses the local device tiles banner.

patches_added.name: Skip welcome screen
patches_added.description: Moves the launcher intent filters and app shortcuts from the welcome/splash activity to the main activity, so the app boots straight past the splash and update screen.

patches_removed.name: Hide Settings Page UseLess Buttons
patches_removed.description: Collapses the WhatsApp, Legal, and Help entries on the Me tab.

patches_removed.name: Skip Splash Screen
patches_removed.description: Skips Splash Screen so the app boots straight past the splash and update screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide File Transfer, Video Playlist, Private Folder tiles
patches_modified.description: Removes the File Transfer, Video Playlist, and Private Folder tiles from the tools tile list.

patches_removed.name: Clean sidebar
patches_removed.description: Hides the Bookmarks, remote-connection and Category sections from the navigation sidebar, and hides Encrypt and Downloader from the Storage section.

patches_removed.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches_removed.description: Strips RsDownloadActivity's intent filters so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches_removed.name: Disable rate us dialog
patches_removed.description: Overrides show() on the in-app "rate us" dialog so it's still built but never displayed.

patches_modified.name: Skip splash screen
patches_modified.description: Moves the launcher intent filter to the main activity and calls the all-files-access permission request directly, instead of showing the splash activity and its full-screen 'grant storage access' dialog.

patches_added.name: Disable Notification Defaults
patches_added.description: Turns off the Toolbar, Recommended contents, and Tool notifications channels by default.

patches_added.name: Hide Settings Items
patches_added.description: Hides the Download tools and Phone clean categories, and their sub-items, from Settings.

patches_removed.name: Clean SnapTube Settings Page
patches_removed.description: Removes the Download tools and Phone clean categories, and their sub-items, from Settings.

patches_removed.name: Disable Annoying Snaptube Notifications
patches_removed.description: Turns off the Toolbar, Recommended contents, and Tool notifications channels by default.

patches_removed.name: Remove from default browser list
patches_removed.description: Strips the LinkHandleActivity alias's unscoped so the app stops appearing as a candidate in the system's default browser / "open with" chooser.

patches_removed.name: Boost Splash Screen
patches_removed.description: Fixes Remove Ads And Remove Ads Lite Gettings Stuck In Splash Screen Useless if you also select skip splash and language activity patch. Also stops the splash from hiding the on-screen navigation buttons.

patches_removed.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches_removed.description: Strips WebDownloadActivity's intent-filter data so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches_removed.name: Remove from default browser list
patches_removed.description: Removes the unscoped http/https <data> entries from MainActivity's first intent-filter carrying them so the app stops appearing as a candidate in the system's default browser / "open with" chooser.

patches_modified.name: Skip splash and language screens
patches_modified.description: Jumps straight to the main activity from the splash screen, skipping the splash animation, the language-selection screen, and any ad/app-open dialog normally shown first.

patches_added.name: Clean sidebar
patches_added.description: Hides the Bookmarks, remote-connection and Category sections from the navigation sidebar, and hides Encrypt and Downloader from the Storage section.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Pro
patches_modified.description: Only Use In V2.7.2. Signature verification is spoofed automatically so the purchase check passes without manually applying Spoof app signature.

patches_added.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide feed save button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide the save/favourites button from video feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide feed search button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide the search button at the top right of video feeds.
